svg.title: Login & customer mapping
svg.desc: The user signs in at Microsoft Entra ID; Cognito maps the user's one assigned group to a customer and issues an ID token to the chat API, which keeps it in a server-side session and gives the browser only a random session id that gate 4 checks on every request.
svg.text: Sign-in happens at Entra ID. The browser keeps only a random session id; the tokens stay on the server.
